name: Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-3.5

coprocessor.notes: ESP32-C6 companion radio is present in the source board design. Exact connections, power/control state and permitted-channel isolation require QP02/Q03 evidence. Disabled software is not physical absence.

touch.notes: Touch may be used for page navigation experiments, not final approve/reject signing consent.

display.notes: ST7796 BSP/SPI path initializes and maintainer confirms a centered stable preview. No separate panel-controller ID read claimed; complete review/control ownership remains a device gate.

camera.pinout_status: confirm MIPI-CSI camera pinout on physical hardware before driver acceptance
camera.notes: OV5647 detected PID0x5647 with actual800x800RGB565 MIPI stream in the source-bound peripheral preview. Decoder/QR bounds, local consent and product behavior remain QP02/Q03 gates.

approval_inputs.name: approve
approval_inputs.notes: Map to a physical control or explicitly reviewed hardware approval model after exact-board channel/trusted-input review; touch-only approval remains disallowed.

approval_inputs.name: reject
approval_inputs.notes: Map to a different physical control or explicitly reviewed hardware rejection model after exact-board channel/trusted-input review.

wireless_policy: Wireless must be disabled for the declared offline operation; identify and qualify all remaining permitted channels on the exact assembly. The ESP32-C6 companion is not physically absent, and software disablement does not establish isolation or a radio-less air gap. No radio/USB/network path may grant signing approval or carry normal operation requests outside the admitted optical contract.
debug_policy: Debug is a bring-up interface whose actual exposure and declared release policy must pass Q03/Q05. No real identity before independent profile admission; ordinary erase/reflash authorization does not authorize irreversible debug/eFuse settings.
production_signing: disabled until actual camera/display/physical-input, shared Rust engine, entropy, no-persistence/session lifecycle, channel/boot/update/recovery and release gates pass
reference_notes: Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-3.5 SKU33360 is the maintainer-declared candidate. Prior ROM ESP32-P4v3.2 and16MB flash observations do not identify the case-covered PCB marking or qualify the vault.

Original source870588e6/BSP2.0.2/IDF6.0.2 vendor build preparation is retained. Reviewed preview candidate9acf6a0 subsequently passed actual camera/display retest; neither result establishes entropy/custody or C6 isolation.
Historical Kern/libwally reference is provenance, not the selected nSealr Nostr engine; the product keeps one shared Rust semantic core.
Another Waveshare P4 model is not automatically compatible. Verify exact flash/PSRAM, ST7796 bus, FT6336 touch and OV5647 connections before driver acceptance.
firmware_status: esp32_qr_vault remains a host route label, not a current embedded application. Vendor preview candidate9acf6a0 has source-bound camera/display evidence only; Q03 must bind the shared-core product image.

custody.recovery: Separate local nsec import from operation QR; power loss requires local reload.
custody.qualification: QP02 peripheral feasibility precedes Q03 shared-engine/local-consent/no-persistence/entropy/channel qualification and Q05 release.
